use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let p = 0.5D
let runs = 5
let expected = 0.065770D

let random = System.Random(3)

class CLUSTERS is
    size: int
    filled: bool[]
    labels: LIST[int]
    count: int

    init(size: int) is
        self.size = size

        filled =
            (0..size * size)
                |> map(_ => random.next_double() < p)
                |> collect_array()

        labels = repeat(0, size * size) |> collect_list()
        count = 0

        for cell in 0..size * size do
            if filled[cell] /\ labels[cell] == 0 then
                count = count + 1
                spread(cell, count)
            fi
        od
    si

    spread(start: int, label: int) is
        let pending = STACK[int]()

        pending.push(start)

        while pending.count > 0 do
            let cell = pending.pop()

            if filled[cell] /\ labels[cell] == 0 then
                labels[cell] = label

                let column = cell % size

                if column > 0 then pending.push(cell - 1) fi
                if column < size - 1 then pending.push(cell + 1) fi
                if cell >= size then pending.push(cell - size) fi

                if cell < size * size - size then
                    pending.push(cell + size)
                fi
            fi
        od
    si
si

density(size: int) -> double =>
    let total = (0..runs)
        |> map(_ => cast double(CLUSTERS(size).count))
        |> reduce(0.0D, (a, b) => a + b) in
    total / cast double(runs) / cast double(size * size)

write_line("mean cluster density at p = {p}, averaged over {runs} runs")
write_line()
write_line("   n      K(p)      off by")

for size in [4, 16, 64, 256, 1024] do
    let k = density(size)

    write_line("{size,4}   {k:F6}   {Math.abs(k - expected):F6}")
od

let clusters = CLUSTERS(15)

write_line()
write_line("pictured: the {clusters.count} clusters in a 15 by 15 grid")

let palette = [
    (230ub, 25ub, 75ub), (60ub, 180ub, 75ub), (255ub, 190ub, 20ub),
    (0ub, 130ub, 200ub), (245ub, 130ub, 48ub), (145ub, 30ub, 180ub),
    (70ub, 200ub, 200ub), (240ub, 50ub, 230ub), (150ub, 190ub, 20ub),
    (170ub, 110ub, 40ub), (128ub, 0ub, 0ub), (0ub, 0ub, 128ub)
]

let image = IMAGE(15 * 24, 15 * 24)

image.view(0.0D, 15.0D, 15.0D, 0.0D)
image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 250ub)

for cell in 0..225 do
    let label = clusters.labels[cell]

    if label > 0 then
        let (red, green, blue) = palette[(label - 1) % palette.count]
        let x = cast double(cell % 15)
        let y = cast double(cell / 15)

        image.colour(red, green, blue)
        image.fill_rectangle(x, y, x + 1.0D, y + 1.0D)
    fi
od

image.write("clusters.png")

image.show("clusters.png")
